profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Specialties: Coordinating with business, management, architecture, development, infrastructure, and QA teams to deliver working systems on schedule.

Building Spring/JEE based systems - all phases of the software lifecycle.

Commercial software analysis, customization, and integration.

System troubleshooting and problem resolution.

Closely monitoring the burgeoning decentralized, block-chain technologies:  Etherium, Maidsafe, NXT, etc.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: CBP - Custom Java development for enterprise search:  Spring, Hadoop, Pig, HBase, Solr.  Meta-programming with Xtext.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Technical Leadership · Spring Boot

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Git · Apache Kafka · Microservices · Technical Leadership · Spring Boot

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: The twelfth hire to Walmart Labs - Cloud Powered Store in Reston, VA, I leverage my 20+ years of SE experience in the Java ecosystem to apply both new and well-worn technologies to solve architecture, design, and performance challenges in the microservices, big data, and BRMS spaces while mentoring Jr. developers in an agile environment.  I am also privileged to participate in on-site interviewing and on-campus college recruiting as we continue to grow our engineering department.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I'm performing a technical lead role.  I coordinate with seven internal teams and three external vendors to guarantee technical aspects of our Integrated Professional Experience (Web 2.0) initiative.  I work with business stakeholders and analysts to define technical requirements.  I implement architecturally significant system components.
